hits.text: [Milvus 2.5](https://milvus.io/blog/introduce-milvus-2-5-full-text-search-powerful-metadata-filtering-and-more.md) introduces native full-text search capabilities using BM25. This approach converts te

- Full-text search is currently available in Milvus Standalone, Milvus Distributed, and Zilliz Cloud, though not yet supported in Milvus Lite (which has this feature planned for future implementation)
# Full-text search with Milvus and Haystack

variants.answer: Full-text search in Milvus is a native search capability (introduced in Milvus 2.5) that uses BM25. It converts raw text into sparse vectors representing BM25 scores, and Milvus automatically generates and stores these sparse vectors without requiring manual sparse embedding generation. It is available in Milvus Standalone, Milvus Distributed, and Zilliz Cloud, but not yet in Milvus Lite.
